title: What the report contains without a valid position
body_md:
The status report also transmits the GPS status. If Pro-finder receives a valid position, only that position is shown. If no valid position is received, the report indicates this and still sends the **last** valid position. It also states the status of both outputs and the ambient temperature in the immediate vicinity of the device.

Important: a last valid position is not the current location. The source gives neither a maximum age nor an accuracy for it.
source_region: Section 5.3, paragraph on the GPS status

change_reason: Extracted from the English source page itself, not translated from the German master, and cross-read against the German page 22: the substance matches, **but** the string actually shown in the report differs between the versions – the English one refers to a missing position, the German one to missing GPS reception (DSC-090). Neither string is therefore reproduced as an identifying feature. This difference was found only by reading both versions side by side.
